coordinate_churn.definition: Compare each successfully admitted candidate's recorded ingestion cell with its cell under the final PCA projection.
coordinate_churn.limitation: This is cumulative admission-to-final churn, not movement measured at every refit.

interpretation_limits: The final projection separates states into cells after whitening, but the audit does not establish that cell distance corresponds to edit mechanism, semantic behavior, or performance mechanism.
Uniform averaging across eligible file embeddings makes raw repository vectors very close when patches touch few files.

The centered coordinates describe the source proposals produced under this campaign's changed-file and lineage distribution; they are not evidence of a universal low-dimensional viable-program manifold.
Archive coverage and front sizes are descriptive because no matched descriptor or search-policy control was run.
